title: Las Vegas GP reveals neon-inspired trophy for 2026
paragraphs: The Las Vegas Grand Prix has unveiled a new trophy for its 2026 Formula 1 race, with a design inspired by the city's iconic neon signs and vintage illuminated marquees. title: Williams unveil special one-off livery for Las Vegas Grand Prix
paragraphs: Williams have unveiled a special livery that will adorn their car for the Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend. The one-off chrome look is a collaboration with the team’s title partner Atlassian, designed to shine under the lights as Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz take to the Las Vegas Strip Circuit. Both drivers will also sport custom race suits and gloves in line with the colour scheme.
